summary: A control machine with a Bypass switch and its own window that reacts to MIDI notes and controller changes as a DAW controller. What it controls was not measured.
use_for: A control-only helper with a single bypass switch; it makes no sound of its own.
quirks: It makes no sound. Its DLL names MIDI note and control-change handling and a DAW control type; the app's preferences have a DAW controllers list: whether the machine acts on those assignments is unverified.
Transport and bindings are covered here by the transport, midi_bind and midi_learn tools.
Closed source (a prebuilt DLL): names come from its own texts, its DLL's type names and the profile, not from code.
evidence: RunTime/Gear/Generators/DAWControl.NET.dll — type and member names read from the DLL (MIDI note, control change and DAW control type)
ReBuzz/Midi/MidiControllerAssignments.cs — the app's own DAW controller assignments, stored by id
